title: Arrow Pop Clear
description: Tap directional arrow tiles in the exact unobstructed order so every piece zips cleanly off the board—a crisp, hyper-addictive spatial brain-teaser.
controls: Tap any arrow block whose forward path is unobstructed to launch it off the board until zero blocks remain.

zh-CN.title: 箭头消消
zh-CN.description: 抖音超火极简解压箭头消消：看准每个箭头的飞行朝向，按顺序点飞无遮挡方块，清空整盘强迫症极度爽！
zh-CN.controls: 点击前方无阻挡的箭头方块将其发射飞出棋盘，按巧妙顺序清空全部方块通关。
